title: Reorganization scenario review
notes: Synthetic draft-scenario case based on AG2's planned workforce-cost/reorg direction and multiverse design; it is not an implemented reorg engine.
reviewQuestions: Can a leader compare proposed reporting changes with current structure and cost exposure?
Does the design make the proposal a reviewable draft rather than current organizational truth?
outcomes: A reviewer can understand a proposed reorganization, its affected people, and cost or span/layer tradeoffs.
A reviewer can send the draft back for revision or prepare an approval summary without changing the current org.
